race.comment: COOL AZ ALETTA (6) is the one to beat despite recent margins that look only fair on paper. He comes out of a BM66 at Taree and a BM58 at this track, so the move into this BM50 is important, and the ratings profile has him clearly marked on recent form, distance and time. Tony Ball's strong local record adds further confidence. SON SILLAGE (7) has the upside runner's profile after winning her Wauchope Mdn by just under six lengths on debut, beating Lykos on heavy ground. The wider draw and rise from Mdn company are the checks, but she has already shown more than enough to be a major danger. MR VILLA (2) resumes after a three-month break having ended last campaign with solid Taree placings in BM66 and BM58 grade, and his wet-track and distance records read well for this. SATURN RISING (3) brings the local winning line after scoring over this track and trip in a Mdn, though he now has to transfer that form into BM50 company after one previous plain run at Scone.
